title: Ather Energy swings to first quarterly profit as revenue rises 63%
summary: Ather Energy swings to first quarterly profit as revenue rises 63 percent
detailed: Revenue from operations rose 63% year-on-year to Rs 1,464.24 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 898.88 crore in the year-ago period.
